description: A ring of chalk scuffed into the concrete around the center drain — the Sump's whole reason for being after last call. By day it is just a stain you step over. By night the stools scrape back, two lines of regulars toe the chalk, and the room becomes an arena the width of a bar. The drain in the middle takes the sweat, the spilled beer, and occasionally the loser. Faded numbers are painted at the edges where a scoreboard used to hang.
name: the slag pit
